### Number of deaths attributed to dementia registered in England and Wales, 2001-2019
```{r, eval = TRUE}
# Load the required package (ggplot2 is included in tidyverse)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
dementia_deaths <- read_csv("dementia_deaths.csv")

# Plot binding and set up the aesthetic mapping
dementia_deaths |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Number_of_deaths))
glimpse(dementia_deaths)

# Add the plots to the graph
dementia_deaths |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Number_of_deaths)) +
    geom_line()

# Add points to the top of the line so each year's value is visible 
dementia_deaths |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Number_of_deaths)) +
    geom_line(colour = "navyblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 2)

# Adding a title and labels
dementia_deaths |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Number_of_deaths)) +
    geom_line(colour = "navyblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "navyblue", size = 2) +
    labs(title = "Number of registered and age-standardised mortality rates, deaths due to dementia and Alzheimer's Disease, 2001 – 2019, England and Wales",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Number of deaths")

# Appling a cleaner white background 
final_plot <- dementia_deaths |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Number_of_deaths)) +
    geom_line(colour = "navyblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "navyblue", size = 2) +
    labs(title = "Number of deaths attributed to dementia registered in England and Wales, 2001-2019",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Number of deaths") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9))

final_plot

# Saving the plot
ggsave("fig_output/deaths_england_wales_trend.png", final_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```


### Deaths due to dementia and Alzheimer's by sex in England and Wales (2019)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
deaths_by_sex <- read_csv("dementia_deaths_by_sex_2019.csv")

deaths_by_sex

deaths_by_sex <- deaths_by_sex |>
    rename(sex = Sex, deaths = Number_of_deaths) |>
    filter(!is.na(sex)) |>                                  # drop empty trailing rows
    mutate(deaths = as.numeric(str_remove_all(deaths, ","))) |>  # strip commas, convert to number
    filter(sex != "Persons")   # optional: drop Persons so bars show Male/Female only, not a double-count

deaths_by_sex

# Plot binding and set up the aesthetic mapping
deaths_by_sex |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = deaths))

# Add geom_bar
deaths_by_sex |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = deaths)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity")

# Add colour and labels
deaths_by_sex |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = deaths, fill = sex)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(title = "Deaths due to dementia and Alzheimer's disease by sex, England and Wales, 2019",
         x = "Sex",
         y = "Number of deaths")

# Apply theme_bw()
final_plot <- deaths_by_sex |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = deaths, fill = sex)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(title = "Deaths due to dementia and Alzheimer's by sex in England and Wales (2019)",
         x = "Sex",
         y = "Number of deaths") +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Sex", values = c("Males" = "navyblue", "Females" = "hotpink")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10))

final_plot

dir.create("fig_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("fig_output/deaths_by_sex_2019.png", final_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```


### Dementia deaths by age group and sex, in England and Wales (2019)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
dementia_age_sex <- read_csv("dementia_deaths_by_age_sex_2019.csv")

# Check it loads correctly
dementia_age_sex

# Fix the age_group order so it plots chronologically, not alphabetically
dementia_age_sex <- dementia_age_sex |>
    mutate(age_group = factor(age_group,
        levels = c("Under 65","65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85-89","90-94","95+")))

# Build the bar chart: age group on x, deaths on y, bars split and coloured by sex
counts_plot <- dementia_age_sex |>
    filter(sex != "Persons") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = deaths, fill = sex)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Dementia deaths by age group and sex, in England and Wales (2019)",
         x = "Age group",
         y = "Number of deaths",
         fill = "Sex") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Males" = "navyblue", "Females" = "hotpink")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

# Display the plot
counts_plot

dir.create("fig_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("fig_output/dementia_deaths_by_age_sex_counts.png", counts_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```


### Dementia and Alzheimer's mortality rate by region, 2019
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
deaths_region <- read_csv("dementia_deaths_by_region_cause_2019.csv")

# Check it loaded correctly
deaths_region

# Filter to just dementia and Alzheimer's, since All causes has a very different scale
dementia_region <- deaths_region |>
    filter(cause == "Dementia and Alzheimer's")

dementia_region |>
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = rate_per_100000))

dementia_region |>
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = rate_per_100000)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "navyblue")

dementia_region |>
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = rate_per_100000)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "navyblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2)

dementia_region |>
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = rate_per_100000)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "navyblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = "Dementia and Alzheimer's mortality rate by region, 2019",
         subtitle = "Age-standardised rate per 100,000 population, with 95% confidence intervals",
         x = "Region",
         y = "Rate per 100,000 population")

final_plot <- dementia_region |>
    ggplot(aes(x = region, y = rate_per_100000)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "navyblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = "Dementia mortality rates by region, 2019",
         x = "Region",
         y = "Rate per 100,000 population") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

final_plot

dir.create("fig_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("fig_output/dementia_rate_by_region.png", final_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### Primary care dementia data 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
dementia_diagnosis <- read_csv("dementia_diagnosis.csv")

# Check it loaded correctly
dementia_diagnosis

# Clean the data: convert Date to an actual date, and Number_of_cases to numeric
dementia_diagnosis <- dementia_diagnosis |>
    mutate(
        Date = my(Date),                                            # parses "Mar_2026" style month-year strings
        Number_of_cases = as.numeric(str_remove_all(Number_of_cases, ","))  # strip commas, convert to number
    ) |>
    arrange(Date)                                                    # put dates in chronological order

# Plot binding and set up the aesthetic mapping
dementia_diagnosis |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Number_of_cases))

# Add the line to the graph
dementia_diagnosis |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Number_of_cases)) +
    geom_line(colour = "navyblue", linewidth = 1)

# Adding a title and labels
final_plot <- dementia_diagnosis |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Number_of_cases)) +
    geom_line(colour = "navyblue", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Number of recorded dementia diagnoses over time",
         x = "Date",
         y = "Number of cases") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13))

final_plot

# Saving the plot
dir.create("fig_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("fig_output/dementia_diagnosis_trend.png", final_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
